name: Ginga Eiyuu Densetsu
source:
Genius admirals Reinhardt and Yang face each other in an epic battle of minds and strategies. As many as 70 other old and new admirals help them.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-october-2008-volume-7.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
天才海军上将莱因哈特和杨在一场史诗般的思想和策略战斗中对峙。多达70名其他新老海军上将为他们提供帮助。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-october-2008-volume-7.html]vndbreview[/url]]
